subject: Redwood demo — May 10 (NDA & vendor onboarding)
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo — May 10 (NDA & vendor onboarding)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week — Carlos and I are excited to see the platform in action. We have a standing slot for a demo on Monday, May 10 at 10:00 AM PT. Before we lock that in, procurement flagged two gating items:

- A signed NDA on file
- Completion of our vendor security questionnaire (PSQ) and vendor onboarding form

Procurement says they won't allow the external demo until those are in place. Can you share Redwood's standard NDA and let me know the best way to get the PSQ filled out? If needed, we can postpone the demo a week.

Thanks — Sofia

Sofia Ramirez
Head of IT Procurement
Acme Health
sofia@acmehealth.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — May 10 (NDA & vendor onboarding)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the heads up and for looping procurement in.

We can absolutely pause the demo until your procurement team is comfortable. Quick notes:

- I've attached our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA.docx) and opened a DocuSign envelope for signatures here: https://app.docusign.com/REDWOOD-NDA/12345
- For the PSQ, Marissa is our security/compliance lead who can either fill it out directly with your team or provide completed answers and supporting evidence (SOC 2 report, SOC2-A, audit points). Marissa — can you confirm the best workflow?
- Rishi (SE) — I'm cc'ing you to capture any technical pre-reqs we should note in the PSQ (networking, data residency, onboarding steps).

If procurement prefers to keep the May 10 time, we can run the demo with a reduced/recorded session for internal stakeholders only, but we recommend rescheduling until gating is closed so we can demo the full platform and onboarding. If rescheduling: how does the week of May 17 look? I can propose a few time slots once I hear back.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — May 10 (NDA & vendor onboarding)

Thanks Vanessa — appreciated. Procurement replied with the specifics: they need the executed NDA plus the completed PSQ (attached as Acme_PSQ.pdf). The PSQ is fairly detailed and asks for evidence (e.g., SOC2 report, encryption in transit/at rest, KMS details). They also want a short vendor onboarding form for our SSO and SCIM provisioning.

Timeline wise, procurement is saying 5–7 business days once we have the NDA signed and the PSQ returned with evidence. If you can get the SOC2 and answers over this week, we can aim for a demo the week of May 17. May 17–19 are preferable on our side.

Attached: Acme_PSQ.pdf (vendor questionnaire)

— Sofia

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — May 10 (NDA & vendor onboarding)

Hi Sofia — great, thanks for the clarity.

Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP) outlining the gating steps and owners. Summary:

1) Vanessa: send DocuSign NDA (done) — link above
2) Acme: sign NDA in DocuSign — target: 2 business days
3) Marissa: complete PSQ answers and upload supporting evidence (SOC2 report, encryption notes) — target: 3 business days
4) Rishi: provide a short SSO/SCIM onboarding checklist and confirm any network requirements — target: 2 business days
5) Joint: confirm readiness and book demo — proposed window: May 17–19, suggested time May 17, 10:00 AM PT

If that works, I'll send a new calendar invite for May 17 at 10:00 AM PT and attach the MAP (Redwood-MAP-May17.ics) and the PSQ with our answers in a shared Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Acme-security-answers

If procurement still prefers a recorded/internal-only demo on May 10, we can accommodate that as a fallback — let me know.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this across the line.

-- 
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
